id: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones (2002)

facts.text: Best food on Coruscant, I'll have you know, and it's all made fresh.
facts.why: No source opened records Dex saying this. Wikiquote has no Dex lines, and the Star Wars databank gives no direct Dex quote, only that he identifies the toxic dart as a Kamino saberdart and tells Obi-Wan where Kamino is.
facts.fix: Best food on Coruscant. I know a saberdart when I see one.

fix_note.text: Best food on Coruscant. And I know a saberdart when I see one.

facts.why: At the Naboo picnic Anakin uses the Force to float a pear-like fruit to his plate and sends a piece across to Padme, so floating fruit is in the scene.

vibe.verdict: Dex's Diner is the one great place in the film and it is used well, but the food skips the prequel's best-known beats.
missing: Anakin's 'I don't like sand. It's coarse and rough and irritating and it gets everywhere.'
Dex's four arms and his diner staff (Coruscant diner)
Jango Fett's armour and Boba as a boy (Kamino)
The clone trooper army on Kamino
Yoda arriving with the clones at the Geonosis arena
Dooku's lightsaber duel with Obi-Wan and Anakin
ideas: Swap 'Spiced blue milk' for a 'Sand-free sundae' with Anakin's sand line in the note (blue milk is a Tatooine thing from other films, not this one).
Swap 'Onion rings with chipotle mayo' for 'Saberdart onion rings' so the dart joke sits on the dish.
Rename 'Clone trooper white chocolate mousse' to 'Ten thousand clone mousse cups'.
Add Jango Fett to the 'Geonosis arena wings' note: 'Boba's favourite.'
